units.source_text: 红日高升，时光已经不早。

en.t: The red sun had risen high, and the hour was already late.

units.source_text: 葵夫人的装束和举止并未特地摆阔。

en.t: Lady Aoi's dress and manner were not meant to make any special display.

units.source_text: 这华美的一行几辆车子和侍从来到一条，

en.t: This splendid party, with several carriages and attendants, arrived at Ichijo,

units.source_text: 但见无数游览车排列得密密层层，竟无插足之地。

en.t: only to find countless sightseeing carriages packed in layer upon layer, leaving no room at all.

units.source_text: 侍从车中有许多是身份高贵的宫女，

en.t: Many of those in the attendant carriages were court ladies of high rank,

units.source_text: 她们便选定一个没有身份低贱的人的地方，

en.t: so they chose a place where no people of low status were present,

units.source_text: 喝令停在那里的车子都退避。

en.t: and sternly ordered all the carriages stopped there to move aside.

units.source_text: 其中有二辆牛车，里面挂的帘幕非常精致，

en.t: Among them were two ox carriages, with very finely made curtains hanging inside,

units.source_text: 而外部装的竹席已经略旧，样子很不触目。

en.t: while the bamboo blinds fitted on the outside were somewhat old and looked quite inconspicuous.

units.source_text: 车中妇女靠后坐着，将衣袖、裙裾及汗袗[\[5\]](#part1338.html#m5)等从帘下稍微露出，

en.t: The women inside sat toward the rear, letting their sleeves, skirt hems, and underrobes [5] show just a little beneath the blinds,

units.source_text: 颜色都很素淡，显然是为了避免人目注意而故意安排的。

en.t: and the colors were all plain and subdued, clearly arranged on purpose to avoid attracting notice.

units.source_text: 车旁的侍从看见别人要他们退避，便走过来昂然地说：“这二辆车子非同一般，不得退避！”

en.t: When the attendants beside the carriages saw that others were trying to make them move, they came forward proudly and said, "These two carriages are no ordinary ones; they cannot be moved aside!"

units.source_text: 不许葵夫人的侍从动手。

en.t: They would not allow Lady Aoi's attendants to lay a hand on them.

units.source_text: 两方都是年轻人，而且都喝得很醉，便争吵起来，无法制止。

en.t: Both sides were young, and all were very drunk, so they began to quarrel and could not be stopped.

units.source_text: 葵夫人方面几个年长的前驱者出来排解：“不得争吵！”

en.t: Several older outriders from Lady Aoi's side came out to mediate, saying, "No quarreling!"
But it had no effect at all.
